citations.claim: incoming normal speed just before wall impact
outgoing normal speed after bounce exceeds e-scaled incoming magnitude
speed grows across the bounce despite e<1

counterfactual.change: Set bodies[0].e from 0.912790531673785 to 0.0; perfectly inelastic impact removes rebound energy gain and no rule is violated in 7 steps.

explanation: Thin-wall (w=0.1) high-speed (~39 m/s) impact gains energy: incoming |vx|=38.89 at step 6 rebounds to |vx|=41.33 at step 7 despite e=0.913, so speed 38.90->41.34 and energy 814->911.9 exceeds allowance. Likely impulse/positional-correction error on thin box (e.g. double-counted contact or excessive depenetration adding normal velocity) rather than e-scaled reflection.
vision_note: The blue circle moves rightward toward the top tip of a thin vertical wall across steps 4 to 6 and makes contact with it at step 7. It remains on the left side of the wall with no tunneling through and no large visible rebound.
